prior_decision.quote: As part of the Reproducibility Project: Cancer Biology, we published a Registered Report ( Haven et al., 2016 ) that described how we intended to replicate selected experiments from the paper ‘A chromatin-mediated reversible drug-tolerant state in cancer cell subpopulations’ ( Sharma et al., 2010 ). We attempted to independently replicate experiments that tested the phenotype of a small subpopulation of ‘drug-tolerant persister’ cells (DTPs) that are generated when PC9 cells, a protein-tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI)-sensitive non-small cell lung cancer cell line, is exposed to high concentrations of TKIs.
prior_decision.location: Results — Partial replication: a chromatin-mediated reversible drug-tolerant state in cancer cell subpopulations
prior_decision.reason: Omitted target: this paper reports new experimental replication data (Figure 1, Materials and methods, OSF dataset) re-testing Sharma et al. (2010), with an explicit uninformative outcome summary stating that the preliminary data do not address the central claim because the remaining experiments were not continued.
